title: Beautiful but a few issues with it
text:
Beautiful but a few issues with it. This is a beautiful island, well built and super easy to install everything. I get a lot of compliments on it and I know it will last as long as I do!

The only problems I have with it are that my wine glass bottoms are too big for the glass holders; the top sticks out over the drawers, making it hard to get to the back of the drawer or fill it; and I'm covering the wood top with table cloths so that it doesn't get scratched.

product_metadata.title: Coaster Slater 2-Drawer 2-Door Kitchen Island with Drop Leaves Brown and Buttermilk
features: Product materials: Asian hardwood, birch, MDF and plywood
Overall kitchen island dimensions: 36" H x 42" W x 42" D
description: The Slater kitchen island is an all-in-one dining or food preparation and storage piece. This transitional has drawers for silverware and closing cabinets to hide hanging wine glasses. The table top is sized enough to prep salads and appetizers. Drop down leaves extend so everyone can gather around to sample baklava or brownies. Finished in brown and creamy buttermilk for a distinctive addition to your home.
